interface.shortDescription: The full development lifecycle for a dbt coding agent.
interface.longDescription: 27 skills covering the dbt development lifecycle — orient, decide, build, prove, ship — plus diagnostics. Reads your project's conventions from a contract file you own rather than imposing a fixed taxonomy, so the same skills fit a project whose layers are stg/int/mart, bronze/silver/gold, or something bespoke. Strongest on the operations no documentation covers: adding a column and propagating it, proving a refactor changed nothing, renaming safely when BI consumers exist, and backfilling without losing history.
